Find another Mexican in HCMC
Jun 2024 • Family
It’s tough to actually make bad Mexican food, but this place managed to. In fairness, most of the tacos and burritos we got were just mediocre, but the nachos were inedible - weird puffy chips (that became soggy) with an Alfredo sauce instead of the expected cheese…just a terrible choice. That and the guacamole was really bland (though they used regular corn chips for that, which is why the terrible chips in the nachos were so surprising), so I’d look for somewhere else if you’re feeling like you want a change from the local fare.
